title: The Three Little Pigs: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: The three little pigs were brothers.
The first little pig built his house with sticks.
The second little pig built his house with bricks.
The third little pig's house took much longer to build.
The wolf blew down the straw house.
The wolf blew down the brick house too.
Why did the first pig build his house with straw?
items.why: "It is quick and easy," he said.

items.q: What did the second pig build his house with?
items.why: “The second little pig built his house with sticks.”

items.q: What was the third pig's house like?
items.why: “But the house was strong and solid.”

items.q: Where did the first pig run when his house fell down?
items.why: “The first pig ran to his brother's stick house.”

options: Fast work is always the best
Good work takes time, but it can keep us safe
items.why: “Moral: Good work takes time, but it can keep us safe.”

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Three little pigs built houses: one of straw, one of sticks and one of bricks. A hungry wolf blew down the straw house and the stick house. He could not blow down the brick house, so the three pigs were safe inside.

items.q: Why did the first two pigs finish their houses quickly?
items.model: They built with straw and sticks. That was quick and easy.

items.q: What did the wolf say at the straw house?
items.model: "Little pig, little pig, let me come in! Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house down!"

items.q: What did the first two pigs understand at the end?
items.model: They understood why their brother had worked so hard: his strong brick house kept them safe.

items.q: Which house would you build: straw, sticks or bricks? Why?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: The first pig built a house of straw
The third pig built a house of bricks
The wolf blew down the straw house
The wolf gave up and went away
